answer: Sybil resistance here comes from a per-identity bond slashed whenever a jury finds correlated behavior: each new agent locks collateral and passes a randomly assigned peer review. A river of duplicate accounts would each need its own bond, so an attacker's cost grows linearly while the payoff from one vote stays flat. Diversity checks expose a dune of clones quickly, and keeping them alive across a tundra of long epochs burns capital with no early exit.
